name: com.uibrik/components
title: uibrik
description: Search animated React components and get their props and source to install with shadcn.

tools.name: search_components
tools.description: Search uibrik's animated React components (Tailwind CSS v4, Motion, WebGL) by what they do. Use this first whenever the task is building or restyling UI in a React project. Examples: "pricing", "animated button", "uptime chart", "text reveal". Returns slugs to pass to get_component. Leave query empty to list everything in a category.

query.description: Words describing the component you need.

tools.name: get_component
tools.description: Everything needed to use one uibrik component: description, install commands, npm packages, import line, props, and the full source of every file it installs. Use a slug from search_components.

include_source.description: Include the full source of each file. Set false for just the API and install details.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: The uibrik catalog by section and category, with every component's slug. Use it to browse before searching.

tools.name: get_install_instructions
tools.description: How to set up a project for uibrik components: Next.js, Vite, or manual copy without the shadcn CLI.
